On July 2, 2026, Wolfgang Schulz expressed his excitement about discovering a budget-friendly Thai restaurant and invited Li Hua for dinner. During their conversation, Wolfgang mentioned specific Thai dishes that he was interested in trying out at the restaurant. According to the transcript from two separate entries (IDs 1 and 2), Wolfgang's culinary choices for the Thai spot they planned to visit together include:

- Pad Thai: He mentioned this dish when he said, "Thinking of trying their pad thai and maybe some spring rolls."
- Spring Rolls: While not as explicitly stated as pad thai, Wolfgang's mention of spring rolls alongside pad thai implies an interest in sampling them as well.

Therefore, Wolfgang was looking forward to tasting pad thai and spring rolls at the Thai restaurant. Li Hua, on the other hand, was considering having green curry, showing a different palate preference. Both individuals seemed eager to enjoy a variety of Thai flavors during their meal.
